title: Selyth Lock
description: The human-approved anchor of a verification: the digests of the Obligation Set and of the acceptance policy that a change must be decided against. A report pins the policy it was produced under, but an agent that edits the policy can regenerate a report pinned to its own edit; only a digest approved outside the agent's reach detects that. The lock is that digest. Its integrity is procedural in V0.1 (a signed commit, a protected path): Core compares against it, it cannot protect it.

obligation_set_digest.description: Digest of the approved Obligation Set (see obligation-set-canonicalization.md).

policy_digest.description: Digest of the approved acceptance policy (see policy-engine.md).

approved_by.description: The human principal who approved these digests.
